text:
jordan: Observed ~3% of prod /v1/generate traffic getting matched to legacy-model-group since the prefix-rule roll. Latency for those requests is 3-4x. Happened ~08:12 UTC. Need a short containment plan.
maria: On it. Can you snapshot the matcher config and recent deploys? @deploy-bot can you pause any ongoing route rollouts?
deploy-bot: Canary rollout for route-change #7842 paused (requested by maria). Recording audit_id=aud-1999-78 :white_check_mark:
sanjeev: Short plan: 1) reduce legacy-model-group weight to 0 2) change route precedence so exact host match wins over prefix 3) add a temporary guard that forces fallback-model for tenants with >500ms p50. We should do 1 then 2. I'll paste the CLI snippets.
sanjeev: Use the internal admin API to set weight to 0:
```
curl -X POST "https://admin.internal.redwood/v1/routes/weights" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route_id":"/v1/generate","group":"legacy-model-group","weight":0}'
```
anya: I'll prepare the fallback override so requests still get served by safe-model. Also suggest leaving a 5% canary to monitor for regressions for 10m before full flip, but happy to go to 0 immediately if spike continues.
leo: Telemetry checks to run after change:
- Grafana: /d/latency/route-metrics?orgId=1&var-route=/v1/generate
- PromQL p50/p95 per model: sum(rate(latency_bucket[1m])) by (model)
- SLO alert query: avg_over_time(request_latency_ms[5m]) > 500
kevin: Watch quotas. If we shove traffic off legacy, some pods on safe-model may hit per-tenant burst quota. Be ready to throttle or scale pool.
jordan: Executing weight-zero now (using curl). Will post response.
jordan: Response: {"status":"ok","changed":true,"route_id":"/v1/generate","group":"legacy-model-group","weight":0}
deploy-bot: Route weight update applied by jordan (audit_id=aud-1999-79). Triggering immediate config reload across gateways.
maria: Can someone run a quick smoke test for tenants A,B,C (high volume) and paste request latency samples? Also link to the containment runbook in case we need full rollback.
jordan: Smoke test (timestamped): tenantA 120ms, tenantB 180ms, tenantC 95ms. p95 down from 780ms to 210ms after change. :thumbsup:
leo: Dashboard shows the legacy-model-group traffic at ~0.4% then dropping to 0.0% over 2m. p95 overall back within SLO. I'll keep graphs open for 30m.
kevin: I've put an emergency quota guard on safe-model pool (soft 429 above 80% capacity) so we don't collapse pods. If we hit that, we'll need to scale reserved pool.
sanjeev: Next steps: 1) create a targeted unit/regression test for the matcher to cover host vs prefix precedence 2) schedule a small rollback-drill in staging 3) update rollout docs with containment checklist.
anya: Filed INC-2026-089 with notes and cross-link to runbook: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-089. Assigned to eng-platform oncall.
maria: Thanks all. If things remain stable for 30m we can leave the precedence change for the planned low-risk rollback window (22:00 UTC). I'll follow up with a PR for docs.
jordan: Will monitor and post any anomalies. Closing this thread when we hit +30m stable.
maria: :eyes: thanks everyone, great quick coordination.
